en.headline: Private car mounts pavement at Fan Kam Road bus stop, injuring three
en.dek: A green convertible struck a minibus and then a bus stop in Pat Heung this morning, leaving a man, a woman and a six-year-old girl with minor injuries.
body: A private car mounted the pavement at a bus stop on Fan Kam Road in Pat Heung early on Saturday, striking three people waiting there after colliding with a minibus, according to local media reports citing the scene and the minibus driver.

The incident occurred at about 8:43 a.m. near the Da Shek Wu bus stop as the green Mazda MX-5 convertible was travelling towards Sheung Shui. The car hit the rear of a red-top minibus that was preparing to pull away after dropping passengers, then veered left onto the pavement and struck the bus stop, the minibus driver and dashcam footage reported by media indicated.

Three people waiting at the stop were injured: a 68-year-old man, a 45-year-old woman and a six-year-old girl. All suffered abrasions, remained conscious and were taken by ambulance to Prince of Wales Hospital in Sha Tin and North District Hospital. The 34-year-old male driver of the private car and the 73-year-old minibus driver were assisting police at the scene. Officers are investigating the cause of the crash.

zh.headline: 粉錦公路私家車剷上巴士站 撞傷3名候車途人包括6歲女童
zh.dek: 今早約8時43分，一輛開篷跑車在八鄉打石湖巴士站附近撞及小巴後衝上行人路，3名候車市民擦傷送院。
body: 八鄉粉錦公路今早發生交通意外。一輛私家車沿往上水方向行駛，途至打石湖巴士站時，撞及一輛準備起步的小巴，其後失控剷上行人路，撞到正在候車的途人，本地媒體引述現場及司機說法報道。
事發約在上午8時43分。涉事為一輛墨綠色經典萬事得開篷跑車。小巴司機稱，當時正停車讓乘客下車後準備開車，突然聽到撞擊聲，發現左車身被撞。報道指，私家車疑試圖切線時失控。
3名候車途人受傷，包括68歲男子、45歲女子及6歲女童，均為擦傷，清醒被送往威爾斯親王醫院及北區醫院。私家車34歲男司機及小巴73歲男司機在場協助調查。警方正調查意外原因。
